title: The integer slice property passes to weak limits (V4(ii))
statement: Assume (REP), (MR), (IMC) and (SL). Here (REP), (MR), (IMC), (SL), (DT), (VO) denote the exact frozen statements of the parent node's dependency theorems cmc_exists_massRepresentation, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, cmc_slice_mass_bounds, cmc_deformation_theorem and dtc_vanish_off_support; they are not available in this child's environment, so the needed ones appear verbatim as hypotheses of the Lean statement and are discharged by the parent proof. In words: (REP) a current with locally finite mass in an open U has a mass representation (μ, ξ) (μ(W) = M_W for open W, μ(ℝ^P∖U) = 0, μ finite on compacts of U, |ξ| ≤ 1, X(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, and μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 if also the boundary has locally finite mass); (MR) M_W(X) = R.measure(W) for an IMRep R of X and open W; (IMC) (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces for nested Borel sets, (b) the restriction of an IMRep to a Borel set is an IMRep of some current, (c) differences of IM currents are IM, (d) IMRep orientations satisfy |orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.; (SL) slicing by an L-Lipschitz f of a current represented together with its boundary, with Z_t := ∂(X⌞{f<t}) − (∂X)⌞{f<t} vanishing on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(Z_t) ≤ L liminf_h h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h<f<t}) and the integrated bound; (DT) the deformation theorem with its mass and support bounds; (VO) a current vanishes on test forms whose support misses its support. Let d ∈ ℕ and assume CL(d) (CL(d) denotes: for all P, open U ⊆ ℝ^P and integer multiplicity T_j ∈ 𝒟_d(U) with sup_j (M_W(T_j) + boundaryMassOn(T_j, W)) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure in U, and T_j ⇀ T ∈ 𝒟_d(U), T is integer multiplicity; BR(d) denotes: for all P, open U and integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) with M_W(∂R) < ∞ for every such W, ∂R is integer multiplicity.) Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) has the integer slice property (ISP) if for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of Y and (μ', ξ') of ∂Y in ℝ^P (Borel measures finite on compact sets; a.e. strongly measurable fields of (d+1)- resp. d-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.; Y(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ and ∂Y(η) = ∫ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms) and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, every pair of currents A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms has ∂A − B integer multiplicity. If X_i, X ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), every X_i has ISP, sup_i (M_W(X_i) + M_W(∂X_i)) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure, and X_i ⇀ X, then X has ISP.
